This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Delphi Software Engineer based in Romania.
 As a Senior Delphi Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development and continuous improvement of enterprise-level software solutions within the media and advertising technology industry. You will work on a unified platform that supports the full advertising lifecycle for television, radio, and digital publishers, helping broadcasters manage business operations, invoicing, and reporting. Your primary focus will be developing new features, improving existing architecture, and optimizing application performance. Working closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, and Documentation teams, you will help deliver reliable, high-quality software releases. You will also collaborate with fellow engineers to maintain and evolve solutions in response to changing customer and business requirements. This is an opportunity to work on complex, scalable technology projects within a fully remote and international engineering environment.
 Accountabilities
Design, develop, and test new software features based on internal requirements and external customer requests.
Improve existing software architecture and system design to enhance application performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Develop and maintain enterprise-level applications using Delphi, ensuring high standards of code quality and reliability.
Collaborate with Product Management, Quality Assurance, and Documentation teams to deliver complete, high-quality software releases.
Work closely with other engineering team members to maintain, troubleshoot, and continuously improve existing products.
Analyze customer and project requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
Apply object-oriented programming principles, design patterns, and best practices to new and existing codebases.
Conduct thorough testing and debugging to identify, investigate, and resolve complex software issues.
Contribute to architectural improvements and ensure solutions remain aligned with evolving business and technical needs.
Participate in collaborative development activities, sharing technical knowledge and supporting continuous product improvement.
 Requirements
At least 5 years of overall professional software development experience.
Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience developing applications with Delphi 10 or later.
Solid experience with SQL and relational database technologies.
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Object-Oriented Design (OOD), and Object-Oriented Analysis (OOA).
Familiarity with N-Tier architecture, with practical experience considered a strong advantage.
Experience using version control systems such as Git, SVN, or Mercurial.
Strong algorithmic and problem-solving skills.
Practical experience applying software design patterns to both new and existing codebases.
Ability and willingness to thoroughly test, debug, and troubleshoot complex software components.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Creative thinking and the ability to develop innovative solutions to technical challenges.
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.
 Benefits
Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from Europe.
Flexible working conditions that support work-life balance.
Opportunity to contribute to exciting and impactful projects across multiple industries.
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Hands-on experience with enterprise-level software and complex technology solutions.
Collaboration with a diverse, international, and multicultural team of technology professionals.
Exposure to innovative projects that encourage creativity, technical growth, and knowledge sharing.
